properties.name: idempotency.distributed-cache.failure-policy
properties.description: Behaviour when Redis is unavailable: fail-open treats Redis errors as cache misses; fail-fast propagates them to the caller.

properties.name: idempotency.persistence.ttl
properties.description: Marker written to expires_at for physical cleanup (default 365d). Always set from properties; use the service builder with null to omit expires_at. Does not affect request-path visibility.

properties.name: idempotency.persistence.lookup-before-acquire
properties.description: When true, persistence is queried before acquire on a cache miss. Default false is insert-first.

properties.name: idempotency.persistence.cleanup.enabled
properties.description: Enable the scheduled physical DELETE of expired persistence rows.

properties.name: idempotency.persistence.cleanup.cron
properties.description: Cron expression for the persistence cleanup job.

properties.name: idempotency.persistence.cleanup.batch-size
properties.description: Maximum rows deleted per cleanup batch iteration.

values.description: Default. Redis failures are logged and treated as cache misses; the request proceeds to persistence.
Redis failures propagate to the caller. Use only when serving without the distributed cache is unacceptable.
